messages:
maria: quick heads-up — I've got a small patch that fixes sporadic 5xxs in the embeddings tokenizer path. Root cause is an edge case in token alignment under long prompts. patch PR: https://git.redwood/infra/patches/456 (ready to ship).

sam: how widespread? customer impact?

maria: ~0.6% of embedding calls in prod over last 6h, mostly long-context requests (>8k). Customers affected are a couple of AI-native trial tenants. Error is `IndexError: token pos out of range`.

lee: is this behavior-safe to roll? any model-compat risk?

maria: no model changes. Just tokenizer bounds check + small rewrite in `tokenize_long_prompt` (20 LOC). Build image `redwood/serving:patch-2026-04-01-abc123`.

dev-deploy-bot: preflight started for image `redwood/serving:patch-2026-04-01-abc123` on prod. Running smoke tests, KV-cache warm, fixture replay.

ops-bot: expedited-ship policy requires 2 approvers or oncall signoff for <45m window. Add notes to release step.

jordan: oncall here — I can sign off if we do staged traffic shift (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 10m observation and rollback gate. +1 conditional.

sam: +1 — reviewed PR, looks safe. I want Grafana dashboard open for `embeddings.errors` and `latency.p50/p95`. Link: https://grafana.redwood/d/embeds

maria: thanks — rollout plan: `rollout = [10, 50, 100]`, checks: errors < 0.8% and p95 latency delta < 25% vs baseline. rollback command: `deployctl rollback --image previous` (keeps previous image handy). Pin: we will pin service `embeddings-prod` to image sha `abc123` during the window.

lee: add an alert rule for immediate paging if errors > 1.5% during rollout. I'll flip that on now.

dev-deploy-bot: smoke tests passed (integration fixtures replay OK). Canary infra warm.

maria: executing deploy. Command: ```
deployctl deploy --service embeddings-prod --image redwood/serving:patch-2026-04-01-abc123 --strategy staged --steps 10,50,100 --note "hotfix tokenizer bounds"
```

dev-deploy-bot: started rollout — step 1: 10% traffic shift started at 2026-04-01T15:22:00Z. Monitoring hooks attached.

ops-bot: gating for full expedite: approvals=2? current approvals: jordan, sam. policy satisfied.

maria: monitoring first window. initial metrics: errors 0.18% (baseline 0.6%), p95 +6%. Looks good.

sam: seeing same on my end, traces look clean. No new error class.

lee: alerting rules clear, no pages. I recommend continue.

dev-deploy-bot: rolling to 50% at 2026-04-01T15:34:00Z.

maria: 50% steady for 10m, errors 0.15%, p95 +8%. Traffic retention good. Proceeding to full.

jordan: confirmed, no anomalous traces. go to 100%. +1 final.

dev-deploy-bot: rollout to 100% completed at 2026-04-01T15:46:30Z. Post-deploy smoke OK.

maria: release note snippet (for changelog): "Fix: embeddings tokenizer bounds error causing sporadic 5xxs on long prompts. Patch image redwood/serving@sha:abc123. Staged rollout completed 2026-04-01." Please @support for customer heads-up. :tada:

sam: tagged release in repo and updated changelog. PR merged to `main`.

lee: removed temporary alert override, marking deployment healthy.

jordan: leaving note in incident log: no customer impact post-deploy. Good job.

maria: thanks all — closing this thread. Will follow up if any regressions show up.

ops-bot: deployment metadata: window=30m expedited, approvers=[sam,jordan], image=redwood/serving@sha:abc123, rollback-ready=true
